text:
maria.product: Quick sync: need final pilot scope for enterprise compliance next quarter. Focus on audit logs (immutable vs append-only), retention defaults, and BYOK onboarding timeline. Who's got estimates?

samir.eng: I ran a quick delta model. Rough numbers: 90d retention baseline + BYOM handshake = +8% infra cost. 1y immutable logs = +45% storage + indexing CPU. BYOK onboarding adds ~2 dev sprints for input validation, key handshake, and rotation hooks.

maria.product: Good. Include worst-case legal-hold cost.

devon.security: For legal-hold, we need ability to pin objects indefinitely per-tenant without breaking dedupe. KMS integration requirement: support customer key rotation with rewrapped DEKs, no full re-encryption. Also need audit attestation flow for escrow access.

kevin.ops: Ops note: onboarding + CS for BYOK pilot = ~3 customer-touch weeks. We should provide a temporary "managed-key" fallback for pilot to reduce friction. Also request: feature flag for per-tenant retention_ttl and legal_hold_override to avoid code deployments for rollbacks.

lina.product: Proposed pilot variants:
- Pilot 1: BYOK handshake + default 90d retention + managed-key fallback + SOC2 mapping. Quick to ship.
- Pilot 2: Full 1y immutable audit + escrow attestation + key rotation support. Longer runway but enterprise-ready.

maria.product: Quick poll: which pilot to commit to for Q2? I'm inclined to Pilot 1 to get customers onboarded and validate flows.

samir.eng: Pilot 1. We can scope Pilot 2 as follow-up with migration tooling.

devon.security: Pilot 2 preferred from risk POV. Accept Pilot 1 if legal signs a risk acceptance and we require pilot customers to have signed security exceptions.

kevin.ops: If Pilot 1 goes ahead, I'll push TTL feature-flag spec and a rollback runbook. Suggest retention_ttl default 90d, optional per-tenant up to 365d behind flag. Will include migration job plan.

legal-bot: Reminder: any pilot exposing BYOK/escrow must have signed DPA addendum + explicit acceptance of non-immutable retention.

maria.product: Action items: Samir -> attach cost + SLO matrix (tomorrow AM). Kevin -> TTL flag spec + rollback runbook (EOD). Lina -> draft pilot onboarding checklist and acceptance form. Devon -> draft security redlines for legal. Everyone: we reconvene Thu 10:30.

kevin.ops: One more ops ask: add an audit-export endpoint in pilot to let customers pull raw immutable streams to their archive; reduces legal risk and speeds reviews.

maria.product: Noted. We'll prioritize export as stretch. Thanks all.
